scope: Recording-site provenance facts for public surgical/endoscopy datasets (facts only). Quotes verified as whitespace-normalised substrings of saved copies (re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s).strip()).

datasets.name: Cholec80
datasets.publication: Twinanda et al., EndoNet, IEEE TMI 2017; arXiv:1602.03012

quotes.quote: we build a large dataset of cholecystectomy videos containing 80 videos recorded at the University Hospital of Strasbourg
the videos in Cholec80 come from one hospital

datasets.note: Single hospital.

datasets.name: CholecT50 / CholecT45 / CholecTriplet
datasets.publication: Nwoye et al., Rendezvous, MedIA 2022 (arXiv:2109.03223); Nwoye & Padoy, data splits and metrics benchmark (arXiv:2204.05235)
institutions: University Hospital of Strasbourg (inherited: 45 videos are Cholec80 videos)
5 further videos: 'in-house dataset' / 'Cholec120 - a superset of Cholec80' (recording site not restated in these papers)

quotes.quote: The dataset is a collection of 50 videos consisting of 45 videos from the Cholec80 dataset (Twinanda et al., 2017) and 5 videos from an in-house dataset of the same surgical procedure.
The videos of CholecT45 are part of the Cholec80 [6] dataset. The remaining videos of CholecT50 are part of the Cholec120 - a superset of Cholec80 dataset.
All the videos in the trainval are drawn from the publicly available Cholec80 [6] dataset. Nevertheless, the testing set containing 5 videos are not in the public domain.

datasets.note: Site is by inheritance from Cholec80 (quoted there). The CholecT papers do not themselves name the recording hospital; CholecT45 (public release) = 45 Cholec80 videos; the 5 extra CholecT50 videos come from Cholec120 ('in-house'), site not restated. Authors' affiliations include University Hospital of Strasbourg.

datasets.name: HeiChole
datasets.publication: Wagner et al., 'Comparative validation of machine learning algorithms for surgical workflow and skill analysis with the HeiChole benchmark', MedIA 2023; arXiv:2109.14956
institutions: Salem Hospital (of the Evangelische Stadtmission Heidelberg) (n=15)

quotes.quote: laparoscopic cholecystectomies from three surgical centers in Germany
The operation videos at Heidelberg University Hospital (n=15) were recorded with a laparoscopic 2D camera
The operation videos at Salem Hospital (n=15) and the GRN-hospital Sinsheim (n=3) were recorded with the laparoscopic 2D camera ENDOCAM Logic HD
Department of Surgery, Salem Hospital of the Evangelische Stadtmission Heidelberg, Zeppelinstrasse 11-33, 69121 Heidelberg, Germany

datasets.note: 33 videos, three German centres. City of Salem Hospital taken from the author-affiliation line (Heidelberg).

datasets.name: HeiCo / ROBUST-MIS
datasets.publication: Maier-Hein et al., 'Heidelberg colorectal data set for surgical data science in the sensor operating room', Sci Data 2021 (doi:10.1038/s41597-021-00882-2; arXiv:2005.03501)
institutions: Heidelberg University Hospital, Department of Surgery

quotes.quote: Data acquisition took place during daily routine procedures in the integrated operating room KARL STORZ OR1 FUSION® (KARL STORZ SE & Co KG, Tuttlingen, Germany) at Heidelberg University Hospital, Department of Surgery
we acquired data from only one hospital
The data set presented in this paper served as a basis for the Robust Medical Instrument Segmentation (ROBUST-MIS) challenge

datasets.note: Single hospital; ROBUST-MIS 2019 challenge data = HeiCo.

datasets.name: PSI-AVA
datasets.publication: Valderrama et al., 'Towards Holistic Surgical Scene Understanding' (TAPIR), MICCAI 2022; arXiv:2212.04582

quotes.quote: The endoscopic videos were collected at Fundación Santafé de Bogotá during eight radical prostatectomy surgeries

datasets.note: 8 RARP surgeries.

datasets.name: GraSP
datasets.publication: Ayobi et al., 'Pixel-Wise Recognition for Holistic Surgical Scene Understanding', MedIA (arXiv:2401.11174)

quotes.quote: Radical Prostatectomy at Fundación Santa Fé de Bogotá, with their explicit consent for data usage
We recorded 13 surgeries of patients undergoing

datasets.note: 13 RARP surgeries; same institution as PSI-AVA (spelled 'Santafé' / 'Santa Fé' in the two papers). The GraSP pdftotext copy encodes the accents as combining marks (U+0301), so the stored quote uses that decomposed form.

datasets.name: ESAD (SARAS-ESAD)
datasets.publication: Bawa et al., 'The SARAS Endoscopic Surgeon Action Detection (ESAD) dataset: Challenges and methods' (arXiv:2104.03178); Bawa et al., 'ESAD: Endoscopic Surgeon Action Detection Dataset' (arXiv:2006.07164)

quotes.quote: ESAD is composed by four videos of radical prostatectomy procedures conducted on patients, which were collected as part of the EU funded SARAS project by San Raffaele Hospital.
San Raffaele Hospital, Milan, Italy
we collected four complete prostatectomy procedure with the consent of the patients and hospital

datasets.note: 4 RARP videos. The 2020 arXiv paper says only 'the hospital'; the 2021 SARAS-ESAD paper names San Raffaele Hospital. City from affiliation line.

datasets.name: LapGyn4
datasets.publication: Leibetseder et al., 'LapGyn4: a dataset for 4 automatic content analysis problems in the domain of laparoscopic gynecology', ACM MMSys 2018 (doi:10.1145/3204949.3208127)

quotes.quote: taken from 500+ gynecologic laparoscopic surgeries
you may directly contact the originator of the videos, Prof. Dr. Jörg Keckstein
"name": "J\u00f6rg Keckstein", "affiliation": "University Ulm, Medizinische Fakult\u00e4t"

datasets.note: ACM DL PDF returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge), so the paper body could not be read. Dataset page (AAU ITEC) and Zenodo record name only the 'originator of the videos' (Prof. Dr. Jörg Keckstein; Zenodo affiliation 'University Ulm, Medizinische Fakultät'); no recording hospital or city is stated in the obtainable sources.

datasets.name: GLENDA v1.0
datasets.publication: Leibetseder et al., 'GLENDA: Gynecologic Laparoscopy Endometriosis Dataset', MMM 2020 (doi:10.1007/978-3-030-37734-2_36); author copy arXiv:2508.21398

quotes.quote: GLENDA is a multi-faceted endometriosis dataset that has been extracted from over 400 gynecologic laparoscopy videos
you may directly contact the originator of the videos, Prof. Dr. Jörg Keckstein
Medical Faculty, Ulm University, Ulm 89081, Germany

datasets.note: The paper text (arXiv author copy) does not name the hospital where the videos were recorded; only author affiliations (Klagenfurt University; University Hospital LMU Munich; Medical Faculty, Ulm University) and the 'originator of the videos' (J. Keckstein) on the dataset page.

datasets.name: SurgicalActions160
datasets.publication: Schoeffmann et al., 'Video retrieval in laparoscopic video recordings with dynamic content descriptors', Multimedia Tools and Applications 77:16813 (2018), doi:10.1007/s11042-017-5252-2

quotes.quote: The dataset contains 160 short video clips showing typical surgical actions in gynecologic laparoscopy.
you may directly contact the originator of the videos, Prof. Dr. Jörg Keckstein

datasets.note: Springer OA PDF and article page returned a 'Client Challenge' bot page; Fraunhofer publica copy behind Anubis bot challenge. Dataset page names only the originator of the videos (Prof. Dr. Jörg Keckstein); no hospital/city stated.

datasets.name: hSDB-instrument
datasets.publication: Yoon et al., 'hSDB-instrument: Instrument Localization Database for Laparoscopic and Robotic Surgeries', arXiv:2110.12555 (MICCAI 2021)
institutions: Cholecystectomy part: subset of Cholec80 (University Hospital of Strasbourg, by inheritance)
Gastrectomy part (24 robotic videos): recording site NOT STATED
datasets.city_country: Cholecystectomy: Strasbourg, France (via Cholec80); gastrectomy: not stated (authors: hutom and Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea)

quotes.quote: The original videos of cholecystectomy included in the hSDB-instrument dataset were a subset of the Cholec80 dataset [5].
The original videos of gastrectomy for gastric cancer, included in the hSDBinstrument dataset, consist of 24 robotic surgery recordings by experienced specialists.
Department of Surgery, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea

datasets.note: Partial: cholecystectomy part quoted (Cholec80 subset); gastrectomy recording site not stated in the paper (only author affiliations).

datasets.name: SurgToolLoc 2022
datasets.publication: Zia et al., 'Intuitive Surgical SurgToolLoc and SurgVU Challenges Results: 2022-2025', arXiv:2305.07152v4

quotes.quote: Video and system data were harvested from surgical training exercises performed on the da Vinci robotic system.
The training exercises that generated the data were performed on two distinct animal modalities, either an anesthetized living pig, or using organs harvested from a pig.

datasets.note: Porcine (live and ex-vivo organ) da Vinci training exercises; no institution/city of recording stated.

datasets.note: Private dataset; description taken from SurgeNetXL (existing saved copy in fm_sources/primary). Country not written in that sentence; the adjacent clause refers to UMCU 'in the Netherlands'.

quotes.quote: The data were collected at the University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street, London, UK

datasets.name: SutureBot
datasets.publication: Haworth, Chen et al., 'SutureBot: A Precision Framework & Benchmark For Autonomous End-to-End Suturing', arXiv:2510.20965

quotes.quote: A Soft Tissue Suture Pad (3-D Med, OH) serves as the task surface
All demonstrations were collected using the standard dVRK teleoperation console

datasets.note: Synthetic suture-pad phantom on a dVRK; no clinical site; the paper does not state where data were recorded (authors: Johns Hopkins University, NVIDIA, Stanford University, University of Toronto).

datasets.name: Colonoscopic (Mesejo et al.)
datasets.publication: Mesejo et al., 'Computer-Aided Classification of Gastrointestinal Lesions in Regular Colonoscopy', IEEE TMI 35(9):2051-2063, 2016 (doi:10.1109/TMI.2016.2547947)

quotes.quote: (4) Department of Gastroenterology, CHU Estaing, 63100 Clermont-Ferrand, France. (5) Clinique de la Sauvegarde, 69009 Lyon, France.

datasets.note: IEEE version paywalled; HAL open copy (hal-01291797) behind Anubis bot challenge; live dataset page (depeca.uah.es) timed out; Wayback snapshot (2022-01-25) of the dataset page lists only author affiliations (clinical: CHU Estaing Clermont-Ferrand; Clinique de la Sauvegarde Lyon) with no recording-site sentence; PubMed abstract names no site. Recording site therefore not quoted.

datasets.publication: Misawa et al., GIE 2021;93(4):960-967 (doi:10.1016/j.gie.2020.07.060); Ji et al., 'Video Polyp Segmentation: A Deep Learning Perspective' (SUN-SEG), arXiv:2203.14291

quotes.quote: The database comprises of still images of videos, which are collected at the Showa University Northern Yokohama Hospital.
consecutive colonoscopy videos taken at a university hospital between October 2018 and January 2019
Digestive Disease Center, Showa University Northern Yokohama Hospital, Yokohama, Japan.
The colonoscopy videos in our SUN-SEG are from Showa University and Nagoya University database (also named SUN-database [3])

datasets.note: GIE full text paywalled (not fetched); PubMed abstract says 'a university hospital'; official SUN database page names Showa University Northern Yokohama Hospital. (The GIE CAD training images came from 5 centres, but those are not the SUN database.)
